notes: Eight February 2026 Google Street View points around Victoria Memorial station and the adjoining Mumbai Highway / Kothapet Road retail frontage. The contiguous southern frontage views show a prominent Vigneshwara Silks sign followed by further apparel, jewellery and tea signs, including Aadaran Men's Ethnic, Raymond, Vijaya Art Jewellery, Denim King Co. and Inko Tea. The images support a provisional relative frontage sequence, but trees, elevated road barriers, overlapping fascia boards and the distinction between sign canopy and store entrances prevent exact unit boundaries, dimensions and complete shop order from being admitted.

observations.name: NH 65 and elevated Metro beside Victoria Memorial station
observations.notes: The station-side road is a broad divided highway beneath a continuous elevated Metro structure. Large piers, stair access, road barriers, streetlights and a guardrailed verge shape the scene; autos and motorcycles are visible. The image is one dated traffic snapshot and does not establish road width, actual signal operation or vehicle volumes.

observations.name: Vigneshwara Silks sign and covered shopping frontage candidate
observations.notes: Four adjacent views repeatedly show a large red VIGNESHWARA SILKS board above a covered shopping frontage. The sign spans several visual bays and includes directional arrows, so it does not by itself determine the exact retail entrance or unit width. The camera chain is approximately south-to-north; facade boundaries and the full shop sequence remain to be measured.

observations.name: South-to-north Kothapet frontage sign sequence candidates
observations.notes: Along the continuous camera path, the visible sign candidates progress from a large Telugu-language board and aadaran MEN'S ETHNIC to RAYMOND; the next view shows VIJAYA ART JEWELLERY above DENIM KING CO., with RAYMOND and an INKO TEA kiosk also in view. This is a provisional sequence of visible signs, not a verified list of every business unit. Trees, kiosks, roadside rails and overlapping upper/lower signs obscure exact entrances and boundaries.

observations.name: Tree planters, pedestrian rails and roadside activity on Kothapet Road
observations.notes: The frontage includes a wide tiled sidewalk, repeated raised red tree planters, continuous metal pedestrian guardrails and a row of parked motorcycles. Roadside canopy stalls and an INKO TEA kiosk, pedestrians, autos and shop access openings add detail. Exact fixture positions, sidewalk dimensions, vendor permanence and the opposite-side frontage still need separate mapping.
